note: Curated provider catalog shipped with the plugin. A remote catalog (same schema, served from a raw GitHub URL) can be added in Settings and overrides entries with matching ids. Model IDs change often — always verify against the provider's docs. Sign-up links support switchXprovider development.

providers.name: AgentRouter
providers.description: Community gateway with GLM, DeepSeek and Claude-family models behind one endpoint. Claude Code clients only — it fingerprints user-agents, which the proxy handles. Free models available.

providers.name: SeekAi
providers.description: Multi-model gateway with DeepSeek and Claude models. Watch for capacity hiccups under load — failover covers it.

providers.name: GoRouter
providers.description: Gateway focused on Claude-family models, including thinking variants. Cloudflare-fronted — expects Claude Code-shaped traffic.

providers.name: Bynara
providers.description: Gateway with a generous free tier — MiMo, DeepSeek and MiniMax free models make it a solid last-resort fallback.

providers.name: TabiToken
providers.description: Token-based gateway behind Cloudflare. Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up and fill them in when adding.

providers.name: BlueSminds
providers.description: Anthropic-compatible gateway (new-api based). Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up.

providers.name: B.AI
providers.description: Anthropic-compatible gateway. Model IDs aren't public — check your dashboard after signing up.
